A positive operator on cluster-indexed connection functions gives the full finite iteration and sign. Finite susceptibility ensures absolute summability; a separate nonnegative identity extends the pointwise result when the required coefficients are summable at criticality.
Summable coefficient norms remove the remainder and justify Fourier algebra. Critical passage retains convergence in the summable norm and susceptibility divergence as explicit hypotheses.
